fields.zone: The physical area or department where the record applies.
fields.role: The job title or personnel classification.
fields.authorization: Whether access or action is permitted.
fields.station: The specific equipment or location identifier.
fields.requirement: The narrative rule or operational constraint.
fields.sensor: The type of measurement device or metric being tracked.
fields.unit: The unit of measure for the sensor value.
fields.nominal: The target or ideal operating value.
fields.critical_response: The required action when a critical threshold is breached.
fields.action: The required task or corrective measure.
fields.depends_on: The upstream station or system this record relies upon.
fields.downstream_effect: The impact of this record's state on subsequent systems.
fields.trigger: The specific condition or event that initiates a rule.
fields.priority: The importance or criticality level of the record.
fields.max_persons: The maximum number of people allowed in the area.
fields.enforcement: The rules governing how limits are enforced.
fields.anomaly_type: The classification of the detected deviation.
fields.definition: The technical description of what constitutes an anomaly.
fields.detection_criterion: The logic used to identify a specific anomaly.
fields.ontology_class: The formal classification of the event in the system ontology.
fields.max_ack_warning_min: The maximum allowed time to acknowledge a warning.
fields.max_ack_critical_min: The maximum allowed time to acknowledge a critical alarm.
fields.pattern: The sequence of events or causal chain.
fields.primary_fault: The root cause of the failure.
fields.secondary_effect: The resulting symptoms or side effects of a fault.
fields.resolution: The step-by-step procedure to fix the issue.
fields.condition: The narrative trigger stating when a rule applies.
fields.rule: A general operational principle or logic statement.
fields.primary_criterion: The main objective or standard for the record.
fields.threshold_hierarchy: The ordered relationship between different threshold levels.

categories.AlarmThreshold: Limits for warnings and critical alarms.
categories.OccupancyLimit: Constraints on the number of people.
categories.AcknowledgmentTime: Time limits for responding to alarms.
categories.FaultPropagationRule: Logic on how faults spread through the system.
categories.VerificationProcedure: Steps to verify a state or fix.
categories.EscalationProcedure: Steps for increasing the response level.
